palette: warm ash dusk, fog grey, bone paper cream, rust seal orange, moss green, plum violet, graphite ink
typography: proclamation broadside headings on ash timber boards, chalked period lines and rust wax verdicts
composition: a proclamation hall with an empty chair on the dais, a missing-person bench, a custodian desk, a dual-period gate, a dead-or-alive fork and a rescission verdict wall
surface: weathered notice boards, bone paper broadsides, rust wax seals, moss verdict stamps
motion: search posters travel from the petition bench through the notice board to the verdict desk, period dials wind up at the gate, homecoming tickets fly back to the fork
transition: the hall dais, empty chair and notice board persist while benches, gates and walls are re-dressed between scenes
